critical_code_review_comments: server.py loads /api routes inside try/except that only WARNS on failure — a real import error would silently produce 404s for the whole domain surface. Consider letting startup fail hard so misconfig is obvious.
routes.py: `assert new` inside order_status will raise AssertionError → 500 instead of a clean 400 when status is missing. Use HTTPException.
routes.py has no auth/RBAC on any endpoint — everything is anonymously writable. Fine for MVP but worth flagging.
MasterProducts.jsx / Analytics.jsx are large — consider extracting AdvancedFilterPanel usage into dedicated hooks once endpoints wire in.
